question: Fit a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) using the pygam library to predict blood pressure as a smooth function of age, BMI, and exercise minutes/week. Use penalized splines (20 splines per term) with GCV-based smoothing parameter selection. Use an 80-20 train-test split (random_state=42). Report test R^2 and test adjusted R^2 (using 3 predictors in the adjustment formula).
